title: 4-cycle-free incidence: every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for it can be replaced by a read-2 one with at most as many gates
statement: ∀ (P L : ℕ) (I : Fin P → Fin L → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' : Fin P, ∀ l l' : Fin L, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (P + L) C → (∀ z : Fin (P + L) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (P + L) C z = decide (∃ p : Fin P, ∃ l : Fin L, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd L p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd P l) = true)) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (P + L) D ∧ (∀ y : Fin (P + L) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (P + L) D y = decide (∃ p : Fin P, ∃ l : Fin L, I p l ∧ y (Fin.castAdd L p) = true ∧ y (Fin.natAdd P l) = true)) ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ PEqualNP.ReadK.IsReadK (P + L) D 2
unlocks: The same on every bipartite graph with no 4-cycle: some no-larger circuit reads each pair at most twice.
context: SKETCH: No proof is expected here in one piece: propose a cut into smaller statements. One move is known to keep size and function: a wire that is below the function and feeds an OR gate can be moved to the output (delete that OR, add one OR at the top). Repeating it ends with a circuit that is an OR of blocks, no wire inside a block being below the function. The open part is a least circuit whose blocks are not single stars: such a block must be shown to cost at least a star cover of the edges it accepts. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
